_about: The Explainer 2 (Ahmed's phantasic `explainer` as hardened on mini2-explainer, 9 Oct 2026; the fork has no base `explainer` id, so this is the whole style, not an extension). Calm, clear teaching: small white pill captions (captions.pillKit: size 50, light, radius 14) at ~72% down that come back only after a hard-cut page is gone (captions.reshowLate), a spaced-caps hook title with one boxed word ('THE / HALO / EFFECT', an `effect` beat; b.fit shrinks long words), and concept pages: a black-and-white painting or engraving on torn paper, or the clause's key word set big (scene kind `cutout`, b.word), over a textured ground (paper / chalk / maroon / slate) while the spoken words type into black typewriter bars that break by length (b.barChars, b.maxBars). Gentle punch-ins every ~2.4 s, few sound hits (the page entry is a whoosh, sound.cutout), a soft bed (lo-fi-02, optional: no track on disk -> no music, with a warning), Ahmed's -15 LUFS master recipe (build/master.json). Footage keeps its colour. Plan with scripts/explainer_plan.py (unwired in the studio).

director.plan: scripts/explainer_plan.py <project>: hook title (effect beat) + cutout concept pages on clauses that name a concept in the art library.
director.rules: Everything on screen is spoken. Paintings only where the clause names their concept.
director.style: The Explainer: calm, clear teaching. Long, unhurried takes; the picture changes about every 2.4 s and never on an unfinished clause. The footage keeps its colour and its grade.
director.restraint: Paintings and word pages only where the clause actually names the concept they show. Everything on screen is spoken. No B-roll, no stickers, and no title card: this look opens on the speaker.
director.concepts: On a clause that names one concept, a `cutout` scene whose `text` is that single spoken key word, set big over the textured ground; 1.5-3 s, wholly inside one take, and never two within 5 s.
